name: conformance-band
title: ConformanceBand
description: Conformance by operation: one cell per operation, with a spelled-out label; the full size can write a label under each cell and a visible summary.

a11y.pattern: <div role="img" aria-label="11 of 12 operations pass, 1 fails">
aria: The band is role="img" with a label that spells out the counts
With labels, the band is a <ul> named by the counts and each cell writes its operation and result as text (icon decorative)
Cell colour is never alone: the label (or the visible per-cell text) carries the result
The optional summary shows a visible percentage and counts as text
Percentage color is secondary: the numbers are always written
a11y.notes: Provide the same data as a table elsewhere on the page when the details matter.
